```{r}
#########Get data in

###Note: here, defining endemics as hits of 1 or 0 on non-Erebus/Melbourne/Rittmann metagenomes.
# this accounts for any potential false hit

###Also note: what containment threshold to use? 0.3 is roughly 95% ANI

containment_thresh <- 0.3

# Define the directory containing the .csv files
csv_folder <- "./csvs"

# Get list of .csv files in the folder
csv_files <- list.files(csv_folder, pattern = "\\.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize an empty list to store data frames
all_data <- list()

# Initialize a data frame to store the row count summary
row_count_summary <- data.frame(filename = character(), row_count = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Iterate through each .csv file
for (csv_file in csv_files) {
  # Try to read in the .csv file, handling empty files
  df <- tryCatch({
    read.csv(csv_file)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error reading the file, return an empty data frame
    data.frame()
  })
  
  # Get the filename without .csv extension
  filename_no_ext <- sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(csv_file))
  
  # Check if the file is empty (0 rows)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    # Add to summary with row count of 0
    row_count_summary <- rbind(row_count_summary, 
                               data.frame(filename = filename_no_ext, row_count = 0))
    next  # Skip to the next file
  }
  
  # Filter the data frame
  filtered_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      !bioproject %in% c("PRJNA431961", "PRJNA366278", "PRJNA366279", "PRJNA685225",
                         "PRJNA366053", "PRJNA366281", "PRJNA366280", "PRJNA1126331",
                         "PRJEB37532", "PRJNA1026874", "PRJNA992360", "PRJNA940853"),  # Remove specified bioprojects
      !grepl("^\\*-77\\.5182", lat_lon),  # Remove rows where lat_lon starts with *-77.5182
      !organism %in% c("mixed culture metagenome", "Delftia acidovorans", "Chloroflexota bacterium",
                       "microbial fuel cell metagenome", "uncultured bacterium",
                       "activated sludge metagenome", "Acidobacteriota bacterium",
                       "Lepraria finkii", "Verrucomicrobiota bacterium", "Bacillota bacterium",
                       "Bacteroidota bacterium", "Bacillus anthracis", "anaerobic digester metagenome",
                       "Actinomycetota bacterium", "sludge metagenome", "Pseudomonadota bacterium",
                       "Abditibacteriota", "Stereocaulon cornutum", "museum specimen metagenome"), #remove synthetic and culture metagenomes
      containment >= containment_thresh  ####
    )
  
  # Add the filename as a new column, but only if there are rows remaining
  if (nrow(filtered_df) > 0) {
    filtered_df$filename <- filename_no_ext
    # Add the filtered data frame to the list
    all_data[[filename_no_ext]] <- filtered_df
  }
  
  # Count the number of remaining rows and store in the summary
  row_count_summary <- rbind(row_count_summary, 
                             data.frame(filename = filename_no_ext, row_count = nrow(filtered_df)))
}
# Combine all filtered data frames into one large data frame, if there are any
if (length(all_data) > 0) {
  combined_data <- bind_rows(all_data)
} else {
  combined_data <- data.frame()  # Create an empty data frame if no rows are left after filtering
}

combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Site = case_when(
    grepl("^Ritt", filename) ~ "Rittmann",        
    grepl("^Erebus-TR", filename) ~ "Erebus - TR",      
    grepl("^Erebus-WC", filename) ~ "Erebus - WC",       
    grepl("^Mel", filename) ~ "Melbourne",       
    TRUE ~ NA_character_                         # Set to NA if none of the conditions match
  )) %>%
  dplyr::rename(MAG = filename)


row_count_summary <- row_count_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Site = case_when(
    grepl("^Ritt", filename) ~ "Rittmann",        
    grepl("^Erebus-TR", filename) ~ "Erebus - TR",      
    grepl("^Erebus-WC", filename) ~ "Erebus - WC",       
    grepl("^Mel", filename) ~ "Melbourne",       
    TRUE ~ NA_character_                         # Set to NA if none of the conditions match
  ))%>%
  dplyr::rename(MAG = filename)
```


```{r}
#look for any correlation between >1 hit (cosm) and genome characteristics?
mag_char <- read.csv("mag_char_ant_volcs.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Dropped.during.dereplication.`)

gs <- read.csv("genome_spot_c40_m-t_clean.csv")

counts1 <- row_count_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(., mag_char, by = "MAG") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(., gs, by = "MAG") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ph_range = ph_max - ph_min) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(temp_range = temperature_max - temperature_min) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(salinity_range = salinity_max - salinity_min) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ogt2 = (temperature_optimum + Predicted.OGT....) / 2) %>%
  dplyr::select(-temperature_optimum, -Predicted.OGT....,
                -temperature_max, -temperature_min, -ph_max, -ph_min, 
                -salinity_max, -salinity_min) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dist = case_when(
        row_count > 1 ~ "cosmopolitan",  # If 'row_count' is greater than 1, set 'dist' to "cosmopolitan"
    row_count <= 1 ~ "endemic"       # If 'row_count' is 1 or 0, set 'dist' to "endemic"
  )) %>% ###########just thermophiles?
  dplyr::filter(ogt2 < 50)

counts1$salinity_range[counts1$salinity_range < 0] <- 0

#proportion and numbers of cosmopolitan MAGs?
counts0 <- counts1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_rows = n(),               # Total number of rows for each site
    cosm_prop = sum(row_count > 1) / total_rows,    # Proportion where 'row_count' is greater than 1
    endemic_prop = sum(row_count <= 1) / total_rows, # Proportion where 'row_count' is 1 or less
    cosm = sum(row_count > 1),    # count where 'row_count' is greater than 1
    endemic = sum(row_count <= 1) # count where 'row_count' is 1 or less
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    counts1 %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Site = "All Sites",
        total_rows = n(),
        cosm_prop = sum(row_count > 1) / total_rows,
        endemic_prop = sum(row_count <= 1) / total_rows,
        cosm = sum(row_count > 1),
        endemic = sum(row_count <= 1)
      )
  ) %>% 
  as.data.frame(.)

counts0

#61% are cosmopolitan
```

```{r}
# Function to convert the quoted format to decimal degrees
convert_lat_lon <- function(lat_lon) {
  # Check if the format is in quotes
  if (grepl('"', lat_lon)) {
    # Remove the quotes
    lat_lon <- gsub('"', '', lat_lon)
    
    # Split the latitude and longitude
    parts <- strsplit(lat_lon, " ")[[1]]
    
    # Convert latitude
    lat <- as.numeric(parts[1])
    if (grepl("N", parts[2])) {
      lat <- lat  # Positive for North
    } else {
      lat <- -lat # Negative for South
    }
    
    # Convert longitude
    lon <- as.numeric(parts[3])
    if (grepl("W", parts[4])) {
      lon <- -lon # Negative for West
    } else {
      lon <- lon  # Positive for East
    }
    
    # Return as a formatted string
    return(paste(lat, lon, sep = ", "))
  } else {
    # If already in decimal degree format, return as is
    return(lat_lon)
  }
}

# Apply the conversion function to the lat_lon column
maps1$lat_lon <- sapply(maps1$lat_lon, convert_lat_lon)

#separate lat and long
maps2 <- maps1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat_lon = gsub("\\[|\\]", "", lat_lon)) %>%
  separate(lat_lon, into = c("lat", "long"), sep = ",") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = as.numeric(lat),
         long = as.numeric(long)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(., counts1, by = "MAG")  %>% ###################filter for just thermophiles
  dplyr::filter(ogt2 < 50)

maps2$tax_mag <- paste(maps2$Phylum, maps2$MAG, sep = ": ")
```

```{r}
#average number of geographic locations?

consolidate_sites_fast <- function(df, distance_threshold = 5000) {
  # Remove rows with NA in lat or long
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(lat) & !is.na(long))
  
  # Process each MAG separately
  df_consolidated <- df %>%
    group_by(MAG) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      # If only one row, return it
      if(nrow(.x) == 1) return(.x)
      
      # Convert to sf object
      df_sf <- st_as_sf(.x, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)
      
      # Transform to a projected CRS for accurate distance calculation (meters)
      df_sf <- st_transform(df_sf, crs = 3857)
      
      # Initialize: each point is its own cluster
      clusters <- 1:nrow(df_sf)
      
      # Calculate distance matrix once and convert to numeric (meters)
      dist_matrix <- as.numeric(st_distance(df_sf))
      dist_matrix <- matrix(dist_matrix, nrow = nrow(df_sf))
      
      # Merge clusters iteratively
      changed <- TRUE
      while(changed) {
        changed <- FALSE
        for(i in 1:(nrow(df_sf)-1)) {
          for(j in (i+1):nrow(df_sf)) {
            # If within threshold and in different clusters, merge them
            if(dist_matrix[i,j] <= distance_threshold && clusters[i] != clusters[j]) {
              old_cluster <- clusters[j]
              new_cluster <- clusters[i]
              clusters[clusters == old_cluster] <- new_cluster
              changed <- TRUE
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      df_sf$cluster <- clusters
      
      # Sample one per cluster and convert back
      result <- df_sf %>%
        group_by(cluster) %>%
        slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        st_transform(4326) %>%
        mutate(long = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
               lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        select(-cluster)
      
      return(result)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  return(df_consolidated)
}

maps3 <- maps2[!is.na(maps2$lat), ]

maps4 <- consolidate_sites_fast(maps3, distance_threshold = 1) %>%
  as.data.frame(.)

nrow(maps3)
```
